note: Documents deliberately kept out of the corpus but recorded so they are not re-triaged on every scan. An exclusion is a decision with evidence and a date, not a filter that hides things: excluded documents are still counted, still snapshotted, and still listed in each report under `excluded`. Remove an entry to put the document back in scope.

exclusions.reason: Agency strategy document, not FSO practice material. Reached from the FCL section only because document links are collected from anywhere on an allowed domain, not just under the source's crawl_path_prefix. Kept as catalog metadata under the same rule that keeps course launchers and third-party links out of the corpus.
